The '''Iron Citadel''' was a massive palace at the heart of the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. Home to the ruling monarch of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and the seat of government in ancient times, the Iron Citadel was conquered by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and was a source of great terror to the populace of Empress Teta during the war. By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Iron Citadel had passed into legend, with many outside the system doubting that it ever existed at all. Nobles on the planet insisted that it formed the foundations of the modern [[Tetan Royal Palace/Legends|Cinnagar Royal Palace]], with others believing that it was buried deep beneath the modern cityscape and serving as a shrine for surviving Krath loyalists.

==History==
[[File:KorosMajorWarMeeting.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Empress Teta converted her throne room into a military command center.]]
Established as a residence for the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|royal family]] of Koros Major, the Iron Citadel was a gargantuan facility at the heart of the city of Cinnagar's Royal District. Named for its iron battlements, the Citadel was a testament to Koros' military prowess as it had never fallen to enemy forces. The seat of the famed Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], it was from the Iron Citadel that Teta waged the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] and improved the political system within the entire Koros system. Having repelled invasion and infiltration by rebels, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Iron Citadel was eventually violated by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Having murdered their parents and secured the throne for themselves, [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] formed the Krath cult and converted the Iron Citadel into their command center. From their war room, the Ketos initiated the [[Krath Holy Crusade]] that swept the system and the region.

Satal Keto [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] in the dungeons deep within the bowels of the Citadel, where political dissenters were ritualistically hanged from cavern walls. After Qel-Droma gained the trust of Aleema Keto, he was permitted access to other parts of the facility, though still a guest without permission to leave. While within the Citadel, Qel-Droma confronted Satal Keto on a balcony where he [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|fought]] and killed the leader of the world. As the new joint leader of the Krath with his lover Aleema Keto, Qel-Droma commanded the forces within the Citadel and had its weapons systems upgraded to better defend the palace from Republic assault. When the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] entered the Citadel unbidden, Qel-Droma [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|dueled]] the former Jedi to a draw before the long dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Marka Ragnos]] named them [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The Iron Citadel's fate after this monumental occasion remained lost to history; some accounts described the Citadel's destruction by the Republic forces during the ejection of the Krath from Empress Teta. Others claim that the Citadel formed the foundations of the modern [[Tetan Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] at the heart of the Royal District, claiming the twisted block of iron at the heart of the Palace's gardens is a portion of the battlements from the Citadel's walls. Still others spread a rumor that the city had swallowed the Iron Citadel, and that it still stood intact beneath the city surface as a shrine for those Krath loyalists that still existed millennia removed from the Great Sith War.<ref name="NoP" />

Despite being regarded as a legendary site, treasure hunters during the Imperial era believed that they could make a fortune by finding the remains of the Citadel and raiding its contents. Among the rumored artifacts to be housed within the ruins were the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] of Ulic-Qel Droma, the Krath [[Translation Talisman/Legends|translation talisman]] of Satal Keto, and an operational [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]].<ref name="NoP" />
